_comment: Dynamics / reward shifts on Hopper-v4, Ant-v4, Humanoid-v4 on one 192-core node, 24M steps per run
(the 12M run took 7-8.5 h per run; 24M is ~15-17 h, inside the 24 h walltime).
5 baselines x 3 envs x 5 seeds = 75, 4 moon variants x 3 envs x 5 seeds = 60, 5 splits x 3 envs x 3 seeds = 45,
1 there-and-back x 3 envs x 2 seeds = 6 -> 186 runs (188 slots with 4 cores reserved).
Seeds: one fixed random set in `defaults`; experiments with fewer runs take the first 3 (or 2) of it.
Each experiment without an `env` is run on every env in `envs` (with that env's paper hyperparameters);
`per_env` gives env-specific overrides. Keys starting with _ are comments.
Conditions 1-5 are the baselines: constant settings for 24M steps.
Conditions 6-9 are Moon gravity with different reward/termination settings. In the 12M run, plain `moon` learned to
walk (Ant peak 1926) but `moon_adapted` (healthy_z_range raised to 2.5) collapsed to standing still on every seed
(761 +- 3: the healthy reward minus control cost, no forward progress), so the survival bonus, not the termination
bound, is the suspected trap. These four separate the two: bounds in {default, mid, wide} x healthy_reward in
Conditions 10-14 are splits that switch at 12M between `base` and one of the baseline physics conditions,
using exactly the same settings as those baselines. Condition 15 goes base -> moon -> base at 8M / 16M.
Videos: n_eval episodes every video_every steps, at each switch (just before it) and at the end.
Model snapshots (<run_id>_model_<step>.pt: actor, critic, optimizers, obs normaliser) every 1M steps and at the end.
Friction note: MuJoCo uses the max of the two touching geoms' friction, so `friction_scale` (all geoms) is used
rather than lowering the floor alone (Hopper's foot is 2.0 and would dominate).

experiments.name: moon
experiments._: 2. Moon gravity (1.62 m/s^2) from step 0, default reward/termination

experiments.name: gear2x
experiments._: 3. every actuator twice as strong (torque = gear x ctrl)

experiments.name: slippery
experiments._: 4. all contact friction scaled to 0.3x (floor and bodies)

experiments.name: heavy
experiments._: 5. every body twice as heavy (inertia scaled with it)

experiments.name: moon_mid

experiments.name: moon_wide_lowhealthy

experiments.name: moon_wide_nohealthy
experiments._: 8. Moon gravity, moon_adapted's wide bounds, no healthy reward: standing still now scores below zero, only forward progress pays

experiments.name: moon_nohealthy
experiments._: 9. Moon gravity, DEFAULT termination bounds, no healthy reward: isolates the reward change from the bound change (compare with `moon`)
